title: When Overwhelmed with Grief
description: When Overwhelmed with Grief in Tonic Solfa to AYLESBURY, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 469 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Safety in God”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to AYLESBURY; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: When o-ver-whelmed with grief, My heart with-in me dies; Help-less and far from all re-lief, To heaven I lift mine eyes.

lines: Helpless and far from all relief,
To heaven I lift mine eyes.
O lead me to the rock
And make the covert of thy wings
Thou art the tower of my defence,

licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to AYLESBURY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
